name: GP Anchor Packaging Plant - Paragould AR

fieldNotes.location: Resolved to Anchor Packaging plant at 2211 N 12th Ave, Paragould AR (~36.0857,-90.4671 per geocode of street address); the roster's geocoded point (36.0526,-90.4887) was ~4 km SW in downtown Paragould and wrong. Building centroid locked at 36.0840,-90.4665.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint where the access driveway meets the public road (Greene County Rd / N 12th Ave extension). Street View 2025-05 shows an open private drive with only a 'Speed Limit 15' sign; site has no perimeter fence along the road. False.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth anywhere at the entrance or along the driveway. A small structure exists deep inside the NW employee parking lot but it is not a road-gate guard booth. False.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Access drive runs ~250 m from the public road up to the SW dock apron with ample room to stack 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: ~16 dock doors estimated on the SW building face; counted from z19/z20 imagery with ~9 trailers backed in. Low-confidence count.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers park on the dock apron and a graded dirt yard; no marked dedicated trailer-storage stalls. Banded 0-10.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main plant building plus a separate large warehouse/storage building immediately NE on the same property.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail line runs NE-SW ~120 m east of the building but is separated by a wooded buffer with no spur entering the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of Paragould, surrounded by farmland and scattered light industry; clearly Rural.
